checked_sources: Independent exact GF2 enumeration and boundary ranks on four explicitly switched 28-vertex graphs
correctness.rationale: All four graphs are constructed on the 28 edges of K8, one as T8=L(K8) and three by specified matching, 8-cycle, and 3+5 Seidel-switch sets. Checked degree12 and the common-neighbor strongly regular conditions (lambda6, mu4), and inspected code for exact clique counts distinguishing the four classes. Independently enumerated every face as a subface of an open-neighborhood simplex for each graph, rather than trusting saved output; face totals 105897,105897,105833,105869 including the empty face. Full GF(2) boundary-column elimination gives exactly the stated reduced profiles in every dimension: T8 H3=553,H5=8; three Chang types respectively (H3,H4)=(253,12), (H2,H3,H4)=(1,166,4), and (H2,H3,H4)=(2,175,24). The source independently re-enumerates faces, performs legitimate elementary collapses preserving homology, and compares collapsed ranks, Euler characteristic and clique counts. This is a complete finite mod-two computation only; integral or homotopy claims are not inferred.
residual_risks: Classification of the four isomorphism types relies on standard Chang/T8 strongly-regular classification, while direct code confirms each parameter set and distinguishing clique numbers.
No universal result for all strongly regular parameter families, integral torsion, or homotopy type was assessed.
